heading: Changelog
lede: Unreleased work is listed here until the first published release. Each release will state its end-of-support date and update channel.

items: Shared Rust core: canonical JSON and content IDs that reproduce every frozen test vector of hashing spec v1; Zarr v3 chunk reading and writing; a verified local chunk cache.
API client core: bearer tokens, retries with backoff for idempotent requests, RFC 9457 problem documents, HTTPS required outside the local machine.
Streaming: encrypted write-ahead buffer compatible with the stream prototype, signed chunks, device tokens, resume after network cuts.

Breaking (pre-release): streams are cut by time. Stream and open_stream now require sfreq (open_stream uses the rate the platform registered) and take chunk_ms (default 100 ms); a signed chunk shorter than 20 ms is refused. Streams without a nominal rate use Stream(irregular=True, chunk_samples=...). The platform limits new chunks to 150 per second per stream by default (burst 300); a backlog after an outage drains within that limit, so 60 s offline at 20 ms chunks catches up in under a minute.
Offline provenance recorder with a verified local hash chain.
Python SDK: nf.open, nf.pipelines.get(...).run, run.provenance with lineage and export, streaming helpers, an LSL inlet bridge, MNE interop.
Docs: four quickstarts executed in CI, API reference generated from the OpenAPI document.
